environment.description: Quarkus Lambda function deployed behind API Gateway (HTTP API) with public endpoint. Lambda has IAM role with secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:*:secret:*. No authentication on API Gateway routes. Function concurrency set to 100 with 512MB memory. CloudWatch logs enabled but no alerting configured.
